title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
lineage: Audience master > ?? > Reel(Mono, Scotch 7" reel @ 3&3/4ips) > Alesis Masterlink ML-9600 > CDR > EAC(secure, offset corrected) > Cool Edit Pro > TLH > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Sub‑par audience recording of an uneven show, with the St. Stephen performance drawing mixed reactions.
ai_review.review: The recordings capture a rough audience tape that suffers from limited clarity, yet it conveys the crowd’s energy during St. Stephen. Reviewers clash over the song – one calls it the worst version ever while another defends its improvisational section – highlighting an overall uneven performance. No other songs or band moments are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Three brief reviews with divergent opinions (1‑star, 3‑star, and an unscored comment) point to a generally weak show and low‑fidelity recording, yielding a below‑average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as 'not too good' – muffled, low fidelity, but still captures audience enthusiasm.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on overall set structure; focus is solely on the contentious St. Stephen performance.
